title:
Europe is only
*a few hours* away.
intro: Tbilisi and Kutaisi are linked by direct flights to cities across Europe — so your travellers land rested, ready for their first supra.

TBS.footnote: Where a city has two airports, both codes are listed with the airlines.

KUT.name: Kutaisi International

KUT.footnote: Some of these airports lie outside the city in their name. By road, Paris-Beauvais is about 85 km from Paris, Brussels-Charleroi 55 km from Brussels, Frankfurt-Hahn 120 km from Frankfurt and Memmingen 110 km from Munich.
